today.title: Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products; Guidance for Industry; Availability
today.ai_summary: FDA가 세포·유전자치료제(CGT)의 역가 보증(potency assurance)에 관한 최종 가이던스 'Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products'의 공개를 알렸다. 품질 위험관리에 기반해 제품 전 주기의 역가 보증과 허가 제품의 로트 출하시험 요건을 다루며, 2023년 12월 28일 초안을 확정한 것이다(수집된 요약 발췌 기준).
today.source_summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a final guidance titled "Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products." The guidance document provides recommendations to help assure the potency of human cellular therapy or gene therapy (CGT) products at all stages of the product lifecycle. FDA is recommending a comprehensive approach to potency assurance of CGT products that is grounded in quality risk management. For investigational products, we describe how to progressively implement a strategy for potency assurance during product development and provide additional considerations to help assure the potency of products that are undergoing rapid clinical development. For licensed products, we describe requirements for potency assurance, including testing required for lot release assays. The guidance announced in this notice finalizes the draft guidance of the same title issued on December 28, 2023.
